title: polystichum aculeatum var. zerophyllum
intro: Polystichum aculeatum var. zerophyllum, commonly known as Japanese holly fern, is a type of plant species in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum aculeatum var. zerophyllum include reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
